                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ দ্বিতীয় থেকে তৃতীয়: 41 - 9 = 32

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      জন্য, (65, 49, 40)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ প্রথম থেকে দ্বিতীয়: 65 - 19 = 49

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ দ্বিতীয় থেকে তৃতীয়: 49 -9 = 40

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      বিকল্প 1) (59, 85, 74)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ প্রথম থেকে দ্বিতীয়: 59 -16 = 43, (প্রদত্ত দ্বিতীয় সংখ্যাটি 85, 85 ≠ 43)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      এখানে, যুক্তি অনুসরণ করা হয়নি।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      বিকল্প 2) (72, 56, 47)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      এখানে যে যুক্তিটি অনুসরণ করা হচ্ছে তা হল:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      যুক্তি: 1ম সংখ্যা - 16 = 2য় সংখ্যা

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2য় সংখ্যা - 9 = 3য় সংখ্যা।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      জন্য, (57, 41, 32)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ প্রথম থেকে দ্বিতীয়: 57 - 16 = 41

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ দ্বিতীয় থেকে তৃতীয়: 41 - 9 = 32

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      জন্য, (65, 49, 40)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ প্রথম থেকে দ্বিতীয়: 65 - 19 = 49

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ দ্বিতীয় থেকে তৃতীয়: 49 -9 = 40

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      বিকল্প 1) (59, 85, 74)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ প্রথম থেকে দ্বিতীয়: 59 -16 = 43, (প্রদত্ত দ্বিতীয় সংখ্যাটি 85, 85 ≠ 43)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      এখানে, যুক্তি অনুসরণ করা হয়নি।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      বিকল্প 2) (72, 56, 47)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ প্রথম থেকে দ্বিতীয়: 72 - 16 = 56 (মিলে গেছে)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ দ্বিতীয় থেকে তৃতীয়: 56 - 9 = 47 (মিলে গেছে)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      এখানে, যুক্তি অনুসরণ করা হয়েছিল।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      বিকল্প 3) (96, 80, 61)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ প্রথম থেকে দ্বিতীয়: 96 - 16 = 80 (মিলে গেছে)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ দ্বিতীয় থেকে তৃতীয়: 80 - 9 = 71 (প্রদত্ত তৃতীয় সংখ্যাটি 61, 61 ≠ 71)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      এখানে, যুক্তি অনুসরণ করা হয়নি।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      বিকল্প 4) (51, 35, 16)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ প্রথম থেকে দ্বিতীয়: 51 - 16 = 35 (মিলে গেছে)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ দ্বিতীয় থেকে তৃতীয়: 35- 9 = 26 (প্রদত্ত তৃতীয় সংখ্যাটি হল 16, 16 ≠ 26)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      এখানে, যুক্তি অনুসরণ করা হয়নি।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      অতএব, সঠিক উত্তর হল \"বিকল্প 2\" 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n262:Ta95,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      અહીં અનુસરવામાં આવેલો તર્ક આ છે:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      તર્ક: પહેલી સંખ્યા - 16 = બીજી સંખ્યા.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      બીજો અંક - 9 = ત્રીજો અંક.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      માટે, (57, 41, 32)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ પ્રથમ થી બીજા: 57 - 16 = 41.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ બીજાથી ત્રીજા: 41 - 9 = 32.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      માટે, (65, 49, 40)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ પ્રથમ થી બીજા: 65 - 16 = 49.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ બીજાથી ત્રીજા: 49 - 9 = 40.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      વિકલ્પ 1) (59, 85, 74)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ પ્રથમ થી બીજા સુધી: 59 - 16 = 43. (આપેલ બીજો નંબર 85 છે, 85 ≠ 43)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      અહીં, તર્કનું પાલન થયું નથી.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      વિકલ્પ 2) (72, 56, 47)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ પ્રથમ થી બીજા: 72 - 16 = 56.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       ⇒ બીજાથી ત્રીજા: 56 - 9 = 47. (મેચ)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      વિકલ્પ 3) (96, 80, 61)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ પ્રથમ થી બીજા: 96 - 16 = 80.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      અહીં, તર્કનું પાલન થયું નથી.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      વિકલ્પ 4) (51, 35, 16)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ પ્રથમ થી બીજા: 51 - 16 = 35. (મેચ)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ બીજાથી ત્રીજા નંબર સુધી: 35 - 9 = 26. (આપેલ ત્રીજો નંબર 16 છે, 16 ≠ 26)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      અહીં, તર્કનું પાલન થયું નથી.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      તેથી, સાચો જવાબ \"વિકલ્પ 2\" છે.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n263:Tbd1,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಅನುಸರಿಸಿದ ತರ್ಕ ಹೀಗಿದೆ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ತರ್ಕ: 1ನೇ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ - 16 = 2ನೇ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2ನೇ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ - 9 = 3ನೇ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      (57, 41, 32) ಕ್ಕೆ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ ಮೊದಲಿನಿಂದ ಎರಡನೆಯದಕ್ಕೆ: 57 - 16 = 41.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ ಎರಡನೆಯದರಿಂದ ಮೂರನೆಯದಕ್ಕೆ: 41 - 9 = 32.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      (65, 49, 40) ಕ್ಕೆ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ ಮೊದಲಿನಿಂದ ಎರಡನೆಯದಕ್ಕೆ: 65 - 16 = 49.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ ಎರಡನೆಯದರಿಂದ ಮೂರನೆಯದಕ್ಕೆ: 49 - 9 = 40.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ಆಯ್ಕೆ 1) (59, 85, 74)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

(ನೀಡಿದ ಎರಡನೇ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ 85, 85 ≠ 43)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ಇಲ್ಲಿ, ತರ್ಕವನ್ನು ಅನುಸರಿಸಲಾಗಿಲ್ಲ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ ಮೊದಲಿನಿಂದ ಎರಡನೆಯದಕ್ಕೆ: 72 - 16 = ", "kn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಅನುಸರಿಸಿದ ತರ್ಕ ಹೀಗಿದೆ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ತರ್ಕ: 1ನೇ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ - 16 = 2ನೇ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2ನೇ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ - 9 = 3ನೇ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      (57, 41, 32) ಕ್ಕೆ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ ಮೊದಲಿನಿಂದ ಎರಡನೆಯದಕ್ಕೆ: 57 - 16 = 41.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ⇒ ಎರಡನೆಯದರಿಂದ ಮೂರನೆಯದಕ್ಕೆ: 41 - 9 = 32.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The princely state of Hyderabad was ruled by the Nizam, the hereditary monarch whose official title was "Nizam-ul-Mulk".
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The Nizam of Hyderabad was the supreme authority in the state, enjoying full autonomy under British paramountcy.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The term 'Sar'khas estate' referred to the personal domain or private estate of the Nizam, which was directly administered by him.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Hyderabad was one of the largest and wealthiest princely states in India, known for its vast resources, including rich diamond mines.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • After India’s independence in 1947, the state of Hyderabad was annexed into the Indian Union in 1948 through Operation Polo, ending the Nizam's rule.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Princely States in British India:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • India had around 565 princely states before independence, ruled by local monarchs under British suzerainty.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • These states had internal autonomy but were bound to the British Crown in matters of defense and foreign policy.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Nizam of Hyderabad:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The title "Nizam" was first adopted by Asaf Jah I, the founder of the Asaf Jahi dynasty, in the early 18th century.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The Nizams were known for their wealth, cultural patronage, and administration.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Operation Polo:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • A military operation launched by the Indian government in September 1948 to annex Hyderabad into India.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • It marked the end of princely rule in Hyderabad and integrated it into the Indian Union.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Economic Importance of Hyderabad:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Hyderabad was a wealthy state, with significant revenue from agriculture, trade, and industries like textiles and diamonds.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
